comment: This project's own citation authorities, read beside the harness's pinned tools/mcp/corpus/index.json by the provenance gate (tools/check-sources.mjs), the docs-sync ADR check and the corpus_search MCP server, all through tools/lib/corpus.mjs. Add an authority HERE, never to index.json: index.json is harness-owned and hash-pinned, so editing it forks it. Each entry: {"id": "project/<name>", "title": "...", "url": "...", "version": "...", "text": "the excerpt you rely on", "sha256": "<sha256 of text, utf-8, hex>", "groups": ["<decision-group key>", ...]}; groups: [] marks a presence-only authority that justifies no flagged decision class. Every entry is linted like an upstream one, it justifies only the groups it declares, and an id index.json already pins is a red: a project adds authorities, never replaces one. The project/ prefix is recommended, not required. Cite an entry as `// SOURCE: <authority> [corpus: <id>]`. A group you add to tools/decision-groups.json can be covered by an entry here. Write-guard-protected, and an uncommitted edit reds gate-integrity: adding an authority is a reviewed human act.
